name: mf-next14-react
description: Module Federation demo: Next.js 14 host consuming React vanilla remote

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix react-remote start" "npm --prefix nextjs-host run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix react-remote run build && npm --prefix nextjs-host run build
scripts.type-check: npm --prefix react-remote run type-check && npm --prefix nextjs-host run type-check
